sources.title: A Mutual Information Lower Bound for Multimodal Regression Active Learning
sources.summary: Fixed independent epistemic/aleatoric indices and Gaussian-mixture entropy bounds give a multimodal regression acquisition. It explicitly warns against moment-only uncertainty; simply adding two latent indices/mixtures would not be distinct. Our possible route must target missing-property conditional laws and genuine feedback, with all within-hypothesis dependencies retained.
